items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: Well, I used to go around and listen to different bands like Kid Rene and Kid Punch and, oh, quite a few other bands around New Orleans. That's how I got started.

ctx.x: Did any of your family play music? No, no, nobody. How come you took up music? When did you start?
Well, I used to go around and listen to different bands like Kid Rene and Kid Punch and, oh, quite a few other bands around New Orleans. That's how I got started. I mean, I like music.
Was banjo your first instrument or something else?
